newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Aug RPI rises 6.8 percent yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Aug RPI rises 6.8 percent yr/yr.

text.p: China's retail price inflation rose by 6.8 percent in the first eight months of this year compared with the year-ago period, the State Statistics Bureau said on Wednesday.
The bureau said 15 provinces recorded increases in inflation below the national average, with southernmost Hainan province the lowest at 2.3 percent.
A total of 14 areas registered increases above the national average, with the highest being 9.6 percent in the northwestern Xinjiang region, it said.
China has set a target of 10 percent inflation for 1996 but central bank officials have said the final figure could be as low as 7.0-8.0 percent.
Retail price inflation last year was 14.8 percent, down from a communist-era record of 21.7 percent in 1994.
